q: Is the clinical need, intended use and care pathway for the AI stated?
hint: Problem, users, decision point, expected benefit.

q: Is the AI system described (version, inputs, outputs, workflow)?
hint: What goes in, what comes out, who sees it and when.

q: Are human factors evaluated (usability, trust, override, training)?
hint: How clinicians interacted, overrode or were influenced.

q: Are safety, errors and mitigation reported from live use?
hint: Near misses, wrong outputs, downtime handling.

q: Are iterative changes to the AI or workflow during evaluation disclosed?
hint: Version changes, retraining, threshold or UI tweaks with dates.

q: Is the path to further evaluation stated honestly?
hint: What must happen before wider deployment; no premature rollout claim.
